title: Click Guard → A script for your Ads account

steps.caption: Google Ads script
steps.narration: Here's how your exclusion list gets into Google Ads: with a script that runs inside your own account.

steps.caption: Ready, reachable, the limit
steps.narration: Three counts: IPs ready to sync, whether the list is reachable, and the campaign limit of five hundred.

steps.caption: Step 1: tracking code
steps.narration: Step one is the tracking code for your website. Copy Code puts it on the clipboard.

steps.caption: Step 2: flags on their own
steps.narration: Step two happens on its own: the flags, and the automatic blocks.

steps.caption: Step 3: paste into Google Ads
steps.narration: Step three: paste the script into Google Ads, under Tools, Bulk actions, Scripts, and schedule it.

steps.caption: View the script
steps.narration: Choose Google Ads IP Exclusion Script to view it.

steps.caption: Written for this website
steps.narration: The script is written for this website. It fetches your list through a private link.

steps.caption: Copy Script
steps.narration: Copy Script puts the whole thing on the clipboard.

steps.caption: A private key inside
steps.narration: The link inside carries a private key. Keep it in your Google Ads script only.

steps.caption: Install in Google Ads
steps.narration: Then three steps in Google Ads: open Scripts, create a new script and paste, and schedule it hourly.

steps.selector: [data-testid="card-step3-google-ads"] p:has-text("Set the script to run Hourly")
steps.caption: Hourly, then check Logs
steps.narration: Run it once to test it, and check the Logs tab to see which IPs were excluded.

steps.caption: The list URL
steps.narration: Below, the IP exclusion list URL is the same private link on its own, for any other platform that reads a list.

steps.caption: Manual fallback
steps.narration: Prefer to paste by hand? Manual fallback copies the blocked IPs, one per line.

steps.caption: Menu: Google Ads script
steps.narration: You'll find this under Google Ads script, in Click Guard.

youtube.title: How to apply Click Guard exclusions in Google Ads | ConstructHUB
youtube.description: How to apply the Click Guard exclusion list in your own Google Ads account in ConstructHUB. You will view and copy the generated script, see the private link it uses, and follow the three steps in Google Ads: open Scripts, paste a new script, and schedule it hourly.
